senses.gloss: स्मृत- + मात्र स्मृत- + मात्र, adj. only remembered, Pañc. 48, 8 (without being called, but only in consequence of being thought of).
स्मृति- + रुद्ध स्मृति- + रुद्ध, adj. contrary to law.
स्मृति- + विरोध स्मृति- + विरोध, m. 1. illegality. 2. disagreement between two or more codes of law.
स्मृति- + शेष स्मृति- + शेष, adj. f. षा, that of which is left nothing but remembrance, Rājat. 5, 189.

1. स्मृ स्मृ, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 1, 3005),
 1. To remember (with acc. and gen.), Vikr. 29, 16; Chr. 20, 17; with the second fut. in the sense of past time, Śiś. 1, 68, स्मरति--हनिष्यति, You remember having killed.
 2. To desire, to long for (with gen.), MBh. 3, 12281.
 3. To record, to declare, Pañc. i. d. 36. स्मृत,
 1. Recollected.
 2. Recorded, Chr. 52, 11.
 3. Said (according to traditional doctrine), Man. 1, 20.
 4. Allowed (according to tradition), Man. 3, 13.
 5. Called, Man. 1, 10.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. स्मर-स्मर्य, m. An ass.
 --Caus.
 I. स्मारय,
 1. To cause to remember, MBh. 2, 2484; with gen., Kir. 6, 13 (स्म्ăरय.).
 2. To give in formation, Mālat. 8, 9.
 II. स्म्ăरय, To cause to remember with grief, Vikr. d. 78.
 --With अनु अनु,
 1. To call to mind, Man. 2, 217; to remember, Bhāg. P. 4, 30, 28 (pass.)
 2. To invoke, Pañc. 258, 25.
 --Caus. स्मारय, To cause to remember with sorrow, Kir. 5, 14.
 --With अप अप, To forget, Mālat. 161, 2.
 --With वि वि, To forget, MBh. 3, 15705; Śāk. 37, 4.
 --Caus. स्मारय, To cause to forget, Vikr. d. 59.
 --With सम् सम्, To remember, Man. 4, 149.
 --Caus. स्मारय, To cause to remember, MBh. 2, 2537.
 --With अनुसम् अनु-सम्,
 1. To remember, MBh. 1, 6911.
 2. To long for, MBh. 4, 149.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, To [] remember, MBh. 3, 15758.
 --Cf. μάρτυρ, μέριμνα, μέρμερος; Lat. memor; O.H.G. mâri; Goth. mêrjan, meritha; A.S. maelan, mal, ge-maered, maerdh, a-maerian, maersian, meldian; Goth. maurnan; A.S. murnan.

स्मृति स्मृ + ति, f.
 1. Recollection, remembrance, memory, Hit. iv. d. 96; Bhag. 2, 63; Bhāṣāp. 47; Rājat. 5, 5; Utt. Rāmac. 100, 14.
 2. The body of law, as delivered originally by tradition; tradition, Man. 2, 6; Pañc. 164, 20.
 3. A law book.
 4. A passage concerning law, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 2.
 5. Understanding.
 6. Desire, wish.

स्मृतिमन्त् स्मृति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती,
 1. Remembering, having recovered one's recollection, Śāk. 112, 16.
 2. Having a good memory, Man. 7, 64.
